name: Hypotenuse AI
tagline: Hypotenuse AI specialises in large-scale content generation for e-commerce, producing product descriptions, blog posts, and ad copy in bulk. Users can import a CSV of product data and generate hundreds of descriptions simultaneously with brand voice consistency. It is widely used by Shopify stores and marketing agencies.
